Taxes and fees at Kennebunkport hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 9% ($16 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 8% at Hampton Inn Kennebunk Kennebunkport to 10% at The Breakwater Inn. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
